title: Same Material · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Same Material · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a visible material such as wood, metal or fabric. The lead points to two different nearby objects made mostly of the chosen material. The group agrees both objects match the material. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Same Material, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group agrees both objects match the material.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group agrees both objects match the material.
